name: ATEK303
author: Animatek
tagline: The ATEK303 acid voice on the M-VAVE FM-1
description: ATEK303 turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an acid machine: the ATEK303 engine from VCV Rack (Open303 with a diode ladder and a modelled oscillator) and its acid pattern generator. Press PLAY and a line plays; generate, mutate and undo patterns, edit steps in a piano roll, add drive, chorus, synced delay and plate reverb. 14 oscillators on WAVE (saw, square and layered combinations), 64 steps, 12 factory presets in 32 slots, OPTIONS (colour, MIDI, fine tuning), MIDI in, out and clock.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Hügelton Instruments). The voice is ATEK303 by Animatek, on Open303 by Robin Schmidt.
